animations.name: light kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One crisp light kick from standing guard to full extension. Settle weight onto the planted rear supporting foot, chamber the front knee briefly, then snap the kicking leg out to the right into the sturdy karate-style side-front kick shown in the final pose while raising the rear fist near the shoulder and extending the front arm forward. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the supporting foot anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
